connectionTypes.sourceNote: Department of Electricity, UT of Lakshadweep — official tariff schedule (PRIMARY, https://powerlak.utl.gov.in/EBCMsConsumerPortal/frmTariff.aspx), NDS-I (Non-Domestic/Commercial: shops, hospitals, offices etc., up to 85kW/100kVA). Rates are quoted per kVAh; represented here as Rs./kWh. A 4.40% regulatory surcharge applies on top of energy + demand charges across all categories and is not modelled here.

Department of Electricity, UT of Lakshadweep — official tariff schedule (PRIMARY, https://powerlak.utl.gov.in/EBCMsConsumerPortal/frmTariff.aspx), LTIS-I (Industrial Service, up to 85kW/100kVA). Rates are quoted per kVAh; represented here as Rs./kWh. A 4.40% regulatory surcharge applies on top of energy + demand charges across all categories and is not modelled here.

Department of Electricity, UT of Lakshadweep — official tariff schedule (PRIMARY, https://powerlak.utl.gov.in/EBCMsConsumerPortal/frmTariff.aspx), LTAS-I (Agricultural Service, up to 10kW). Larger agricultural connections (LTAS-II/III, beyond 10kW up to 85kW/100kVA) pay the same Rs.3.25/unit rate on a kVAh basis with the same Rs.10/kVA fixed charge, so this figure applies broadly across the category.
